process.title: A modern approach to digital.
process.desc: We don't just build. We partner, strategize, and elevate. Our process is built on a transparent foundation of three key pillars.
process.step1_desc: We start by diving deep. We analyze your brand, audience, and goals to build a comprehensive roadmap. This isn't just a plan; it's the blueprint for your digital success.
process.step2_desc: This is where vision becomes reality. Our team creates pixel-perfect, intuitive designs and writes clean, scalable code. We focus on creating a seamless user experience.
process.step3_desc: Launch is just the beginning. We deploy your project and then obsess over performance, using tools like Google Ads and SEO to drive traffic and build loyalty.

faq.title: Clarify your confusion.
faq.a1: A domain name is your website's unique address on the internet, like 'nekdigital.nl'. It's how people find you.
faq.a2: Web hosting is the service that stores your website's files on a server, making it accessible to anyone on the web.
faq.q3: How long does a website take?
faq.a3: A standard business website typically takes 4-6 weeks from start to launch, depending on the complexity and content.
faq.q4: What is the investment for a new website?
faq.a4: Our packages start from €159 per month, but we provide custom quotes based on your specific needs and goals.
